format: reStructuredText (RST) documentation and PHP code snippets
description: This file is a README file for the jmespath.php library, which is a PHP implementation of the JMESPath query language. It contains an overview of the library, usage instructions, runtime details, environment variables, and testing procedures, along with example code snippets.

classes.name: JmesPath\AstRuntime
classes.description: A runtime class that interprets and evaluates JMESPath expressions by parsing them into an AST and interpreting the tree.

classes.name: JmesPath\CompilerRuntime
classes.description: A runtime class that pre-compiles JMESPath expressions to PHP source code for high-performance repeated evaluations.

methods.name: search
methods.description: A function that executes a JMESPath query on a given data structure, either using AstRuntime or CompilerRuntime depending on environment settings.
